title: [Sutana's Designs, Wall Decor]
description: Soft textiles and framed pieces line the walls, hung from slender rails and wooden pegs arranged at varying heights.  Embroidered hoops, stitched charts, and woven tapestries share space with sketches, maps, and sculptural accents, each displayed with care.  Gentle lantern light warms linen, cotton, and flax, deepening dyes and drawing out fine threadwork, while small placards beneath each piece note materials, techniques, and origin.
